title: Donald Trump exposed one truth about Obama's picture that left CNN scrambling for cover
text:
The fake news media is at it again with their latest manufactured controversy.
They thought they had Trump cornered with accusations involving former President Barack Obama.
And Donald Trump exposed one truth about an Obama picture that left CNN scrambling for cover.
CNN tries to create fake scandal about portrait placement CNN breathlessly reported on Sunday that President Donald Trump committed some sort of grave offense by moving Barack Obama’s official White House portrait to a "hidden stairwell."
The network’s dramatic headline made it sound like Trump banished Obama’s portrait to some basement storage closet.
But here’s what CNN conveniently left out of their sensationalized reporting.
Trump moved Obama’s portrait to the Grand Staircase – one of the most prestigious and historic locations in the entire White House.
The Grand Staircase leads directly to the presidential residence and serves as the backdrop for the Presidential Entrance March ceremony when Trump welcomes visiting foreign dignitaries.
Multiple former presidents throughout history have had their portraits displayed in this exact location.
So much for CNN’s "hidden stairwell" narrative.
The timing of this move wasn’t coincidental either.
Trump ordered the relocation as Attorney General Pam Bondi ordered prosecutors to begin a grand jury investigation into allegations that top Obama administration officials manufactured intelligence about Russia’s interference in the 2016 election.¹
The Grand Staircase carries special significance The location where Obama’s portrait now hangs is actually steeped in White House history and tradition.
Presidents have used the Grand Staircase for decades to welcome heads of state and conduct official ceremonies.
The staircase features portraits of several presidents and serves as a direct pathway to the presidential residence.
CNN characterized this as "heavily restricted" and "out of view" to make Trump’s decision sound petty and vindictive.
But anyone familiar with White House operations knows the Grand Staircase represents one of the building’s most dignified and ceremonial spaces.
The fake news media counted on their audience not understanding White House geography and protocols.
They figured most people would read "hidden stairwell" and picture Obama’s portrait stuffed in some dark corner next to the furnace.
Media meltdown exposes their real agenda Conservative voices quickly called out CNN’s deceptive framing of the story.
RedState noted that considering Obama’s role in what CIA Director John Ratcliffe described as "the greatest scandal of a lifetime," the former President should feel fortunate his portrait hangs anywhere in the White House.²
The truth is that leftists would manufacture outrage no matter where Trump placed Obama’s portrait.
Every image of Obama represents a holy relic to them.
CNN and their fellow travelers in the mainstream media were never going to give Trump credit for maintaining Obama’s portrait in a place of honor.
They needed a controversy to distract from the growing evidence of Obama administration corruption that’s being uncovered by Trump’s Justice Department.
Trump exercises legitimate presidential authority Presidents have always possessed the constitutional authority to redecorate the White House according to their preferences.
During his first term, Trump moved portraits of Bill Clinton and George W. Bush from the Grand Foyer and replaced them with paintings of William McKinley and Theodore Roosevelt.
Nobody screamed about "breaking protocol" then because the media wasn’t actively trying to undermine Trump’s legitimacy at that point in his presidency.
Multiple sources confirmed that Trump involves himself in nearly every aesthetic decision about White House décor, which is perfectly within his rights as President.
The only real change from moving Obama’s portrait is that tourists taking White House tours will no longer be forced to see the former President’s image when they enter the building.
Democrats can’t stand the idea that visitors won’t have to stare at their cult hero the moment they step inside America’s most important residence.
What this really reveals about media bias CNN’s dishonest reporting about Obama’s portrait location perfectly encapsulates everything wrong with modern journalism.
They took a perfectly legitimate presidential decision and twisted it into a scandal through selective word choice and deliberate omissions.
Calling the Grand Staircase a "hidden stairwell" represents the kind of editorial manipulation that has destroyed public trust in mainstream media.
The network knew most of their audience would never read past the inflammatory headline to learn the actual facts.
Mission accomplished for CNN – they generated the fake outrage they were desperate to create on what must have been a slow news day.
This pattern of deceptive reporting explains why Trump’s supporters have learned to automatically distrust anything CNN publishes.
When nearly every story contains deliberate distortions designed to make Trump look bad, the network’s credibility evaporates completely.
The American people elected Trump to drain the swamp and restore accountability to Washington, D.C.
Moving Obama’s portrait to reflect current political realities represents exactly the kind of symbolic change voters demanded when they handed Trump his landslide victory.
